metadata.description: Final combined EgoTactile mapping v2: pressure uses hybrid_v2; bend uses full TouchAnything bend-strip spatial support.
metadata.bend_mapping_source: TouchAnything full bend-strip geometry derived from official 21x21 mapping and ta_to_mano_mapping_left_visual.json
metadata.bend_handling: Each JQ/EgoTactile bend signal remains ONE logical channel. For spatial visualization/auxiliary MANO representation, that one value is broadcast over the full TA bend strip. The three TA raw indices within a strip are preserved as provenance only and are NOT treated as three independent EgoTactile bend values.

recommended_use.bend: Keep as a separate bend branch or auxiliary signal; do not mix with pressure as if it were physical contact pressure.
